newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Koncar soaring.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Koncar soaring.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in lively trade on Tuesday, with electrical manufacturer Koncar soaring.
* Volume rose to 10,016 units, turnover 4,8 million kuna.
* Five of 14 active issues rose, two were flat and seven fell.
* Biggest gainer Koncar rose 1,090 kuna to 1,460 on volume of 78 shares, in its first transaction this year.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Istraturist lost 15 kuna to 205 on volume of 38 shares.
* Most active stock food processor Podravka sold 3,889 shares, inching down five kuna to 305. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075.
